environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'doc-services' with IAM role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/DocPreviewServiceRole attached via IRSA. The role has broad permissions including sts:AssumeRole, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, lambda:InvokeFunction. No network policies restrict egress from the pod. The InternalFetchView endpoint is exposed on the same ALB as public endpoints with no path-based authentication distinction. IMDS v1 is enabled on the node (hop limit=2, HttpTokens=optional).
